message.content:
Based on the provided screenshots, here are the visual problems identified:

*   **Sticky Bottom Navigation Overlapping Content (Image 1):** The bottom action bar (with icons for Profile, Orders, etc.) overlaps the product information card, specifically covering the "مغز پسته احمد آقایی" (Ahmad Aghaei Pistachio Kernel) title and the top of the seller details card.
*   **Cut-off Text (Image 1):** The breadcrumb navigation at the top ("دانه > خشکبار > بيس..." and "کشور ایران,٩٩") appears truncated or cut off on the right side.
*   **Watermark Obstruction (Image 1):** The "buskool" watermark is placed directly in the center of the main product image, obstructing the view of the pistachios.
